The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Områden känsliga för övergödning enligt avloppsvattendirektivet (91/27; Avloppsvattendirektivet (91/271/EEG) nedladdningstjänst ATOM; Avloppsvattendirektivet (91/271/EEG), visningstjänst; Avloppsvattendirektivet (91/271/EEG), områden, visningstjänst. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#CC01.0), as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
